articles.title: Bellway (LSE:BWY) Stock Can FY 2026 Earnings Sustain Cash Strength?
articles.summary: Bellway just dropped its full year 2026 numbers into a market that had already nudged the stock up, with the share price at £22.62 after a solid run over the past month. The headline is simple: more homes, more profit, yet thinner margins. Volumes reached 9,695 completions and operating profit came in at £321m, while the operating margin sat at 10.1% as cost pressure bit.
